title: 适龄的朋友
summary: 每个人不会向年龄 y 满足 y<=x/2+7、y>x 或 y>100 且 x<100 的人发送请求，求所有有序好友请求数量。
insight: 年龄范围仅 1..120，统计每个年龄人数，再枚举发送者与接收者年龄；合法年龄对贡献 count[x]*count[y]，同龄时排除自己。
pitfalls: 同一人不能向自己发送
年龄条件使用整数比较可写成 2*y<=x+14

solutions.title: 年龄频次数对枚举
solutions.idea: 在固定小年龄域上聚合计算请求数。
steps: 枚举 sender、receiver 且频次非零，按三条规则跳过不合法年龄对
贡献 count[sender]*count[receiver]，同龄再减 count[sender] 排除自请求

code.java: class Solution { public int numFriendRequests(int[] ages){int[] count=new int[121];for(int age:ages)count[age]++;int answer=0;for(int sender=1;sender<=120;sender++)for(int receiver=1;receiver<=120;receiver++){if(count[sender]==0||count[receiver]==0||2*receiver<=sender+14||receiver>sender||receiver>100&&sender<100)continue;answer+=count[sender]*count[receiver]-(sender==receiver?count[sender]:0);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numFriendRequests(ages:IntArray):Int{val count=IntArray(121);for(age in ages)count[age]++;var answer=0;for(sender in 1..120)for(receiver in 1..120){if(count[sender]==0||count[receiver]==0||2*receiver<=sender+14||receiver>sender||receiver>100&&sender<100)continue;answer+=count[sender]*count[receiver]-if(sender==receiver)count[sender] else 0};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numFriendRequests(vector<int>& ages){int count[121]{};for(int age:ages)++count[age];int answer=0;for(int sender=1;sender<=120;++sender)for(int receiver=1;receiver<=120;++receiver){if(!count[sender]||!count[receiver]||2*receiver<=sender+14||receiver>sender||(receiver>100&&sender<100))continue;answer+=count[sender]*count[receiver]-(sender==receiver?count[sender]:0);}return answer;} };
